partition: Train captures split into chronologically ordered 30-minute blocks: first 60% train, next 15% validation, next 10% calibration, last 15% known_test. First 60 seconds of each block are context-only and not scored. All context resets at each block.
pretraining: Normal training states only: masked final service recovery and real-sequence continuation discrimination with donor normal events. Counterfactuals are auxiliary self-supervised targets, never attack ground truth.
threshold: Select with calibration labels only, maximum F1 at <=1% observed normal FPR; never use final tests
selection: Mean AP over validation and entirely weight-training-held-out Muhstik proxy_validation for checkpoints; no checkpoint/threshold adjustment based on final tests
zero_day_limit: New domain-fine-tuning malware families/captures, not proven absence from foundation pretraining or new attack techniques
